title.narrative: Sustainable Food System Ireland Scoping livestock traceability EMBNBO/2021

description.narrative: Partner: Sustainable Food Systems Ireland (SFSI) Project Title: 'Scoping Mission on Livestock Identification and Traceability, Kenya'Project Objective: A study to understand better how Irish experience and expertise might be applied to support Kenyan partners in relation to LITS implementationProject Activities: A scoping study to understand better how Irish experience, expertise might be applied to support Kenyan partners in relations to Livestock and Traceability Systems (LITS) implementation. SFSI team and a senior veterinary expert from Ireland engaged with a range of Kenyan stakeholders with a focus on the cattle sector, which is commonly the largest part of investment for LITS programme around the world. The scoping mission report is finalized and will inform the next steps of the process
